items.summary: Security disposition: evidence_needed, not clear. Fleet-doctor has no run or findings; operations has no deploy, uptime, or error sweep results; security sitefacts are unknown for all 61 in-scope sites. Authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release/deploy controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and security.txt/disclosure readiness are unevidenced. No TLS certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but complete TLS configuration is not evidenced. Compliance reports 36 pass, 19 fail, and 6 unknown; this is a technical baseline, not certification. No evidence of compromise is present. Risk severity is high for new public exposure or security-sensitive releases, and unknown for ordinary reversible growth. Exact decision: keep private-launch and security-sensitive release gates unchanged; permit the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement only after capacity release and normal validation, provided it adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, telemetry, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Continue the existing consolidated read-only security evidence matrix; do not request duplicate telemetry, retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions, deploy, or claim clearance.

Security handoff: use the existing security-fleet-control-evidence work item; do not create a duplicate. Record dated evidence and explicit unknowns for authentication/access boundaries, secrets exposure, container isolation, release and deployment controls, dependency and supply-chain provenance, TLS configuration, data exposure, monitoring and incident signals, and security.txt/disclosure readiness. Reconsider clearance only after evidence is attached and an owner-approved disposition exists.

Security review of the candidate plan: retain containment. The queued allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement is ordinary reversible growth and may remain capacity-gated, subject to preserved destination/tracking ID, disclosure, keyboard focus, deterministic validation, rollback, and no new credentials, permissions, dependencies, telemetry, or cross-site behavior. Do not clear any launch gate, admit site-factory publication, or expose gated products until the security evidence matrix and required owner dispositions are complete.
